None yet. With a car route shown, tap a town or a point on the route, then Avoid.

Car routes never use these roads or pass through these areas, except when your start, destination or a stop is in one; they are drawn in red on the map. To add one, show a car route, then tap a town or village the route passes through, or tap (or long-press) a point on the route, and choose Avoid; it may be under More.
Your avoided roads and places may be blocking every route. You can switch some off in Settings → Navigation → Avoided roads and places.
